title: Labelled code
description: A code block with the file or command it belongs to as a small label above it, or alone. On a page: <pd-components-labelled-code label="…"> holding a fenced code block, which may show a pd- tag as code.

label.description: The file the code is from, or the command that printed it, as the figure's caption above the block. Left out, the block stands alone

code.description: The tag's content: one fenced code block, as markdown
